gutenberg_excluded_margins.reading: BOTH preregistered margins WIDEN when the leaked family is excluded: frozen +0.1073 vs +0.1003, expanded +0.0620 vs +0.0583. The split defect, corrected for, improves the result it contaminated - every baseline is also weaker on gutenberg than elsewhere, so the leak was depressing the headline, not inflating it.

why: Derived after an adversarial audit confirmed two defects: (1) the paired bootstrap resampled 260000 eval fragments as independent although they are 10000 clusters of 26 fragments sharing a plaintext - the very dependence unit the grouped split declares; (2) gutenberg-family chunks are windows drawn from one shared 7.84 MB pool, so gutenberg source bytes straddle train/eval and the grouped-split guarantee is false for that eighth of the corpus. Everything here is recomputed from the BANKED per-example scores; no model was re-run.
